en.title: Buying a Chinese bike in the US or Canada: where to order and what to check
en.description: Compare direct brands, local dealers and regional warehouses across ten Chinese bike makers, with separate US and Canadian import guidance and dated owner experiences.
en.intro: The tempting frame price is only the opening number. A good US or Canadian purchase starts with the actual seller, dispatch country and support arrangement—and ends with a bike that fits, with no mystery invoice waiting beside the box.

sections.heading: Ten brands, several different ways to buy
paragraphs: Direct ordering is common, but it is not the only route. Winspace and SEKA publish dealer directories; ICAN advertises selected US-warehouse products; LightCarbon and Dengfu are useful examples of quote-led ordering. The route can change within one brand according to the item and destination.

Use the official links below to locate the current seller, then ask about the exact model, size, finish and cockpit. A US flag on a shop banner does not establish Canadian duty treatment, and a regional warehouse does not guarantee every option is sitting on its shelf.

This is a practical selection of ten brands and frame suppliers, not a claim that they are the ten largest by sales. These routes were checked on September 22, 2026; stock and terms need a fresh confirmation when you order.
bullets: [Winspace](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/authorized-dealers): Brand shop or listed dealer; ask which warehouse supplies the exact order.
[Elves](https://elvesbike.com/terms.php): Brand or country distributor; get a paint and production quote.
[YOELEO](https://www.yoeleobike.com/pages/shipping-and-delivery): Global or regional store; warehouse and tax terms depend on the order.
[ICAN](https://icancycling.com/collections/carbon-disc-wheels-usa): Direct shop with selected regional stock; verify the actual SKU.
[LightCarbon](https://www.lightcarbon.com/warranty_d10): Contact the manufacturer for an itemized frame and shipping quote.
[SEKA](https://www.sekabikes.com/en/seka-global-dealer/): Start with the current global dealer directory.
[Tavelo](https://tavelo.cc/pages/dealer): Brand site and dealer locator; check exact generation and stock.
[PARDUS](https://pardusbicycle.com/dealers/): Check the global dealer network for your country.
[VeloBuild](https://www.velobuild.com/place-order-a0025.html): Website order followed by written configuration confirmation.
[Dengfu](https://m.dengfubikes.com/about/): Direct manufacturer inquiry; confirm model, stock and package.

sections.heading: For US buyers: retire the old $800 shortcut
paragraphs: Old forum advice often assumes that a low-value shipment enters the US duty-free. [CBP’s guidance updated in February 2026](https://www.help.cbp.gov/s/article/Article-1050) says duty-free de minimis treatment for shipments valued at $800 or less was suspended for all countries from August 29, 2025. A successful import from several years ago is not a current quote.

Do not replace that obsolete rule with one universal bicycle tariff. The classification, origin and measures in force at import matter, and a complete bicycle is not automatically treated like a frame or a wheelset. Ask the seller or carrier for the expected charges on your exact shipment, and check current CBP guidance immediately before paying.

Local US stock can make the buying process simpler when the advertised delivered price covers that actual item and address. [ICAN’s US warehouse collection](https://icancycling.com/collections/carbon-disc-wheels-usa) is an example of a specific offer, not evidence that all ICAN products or all Canadian deliveries have the same treatment.

Have the seller state what happens if the carrier requests an additional payment. Save the written answer. Do not agree to a false value, gift declaration or misleading item description to make the spreadsheet work.

sections.heading: For Canadian buyers: a US store is still across a border
paragraphs: Use [CBSA’s courier-import guidance](https://www.cbsa-asfc.gc.ca/import/courier/menu-eng.html) and its [postal duty and tax guidance](https://www.cbsa-asfc.gc.ca/import/postal-postale/dtytx-drttx-eng.html) for the route you are using. Duties, applicable taxes and a courier’s own clearance or brokerage services are different line items.

The [2026 Canadian tariff chapter for vehicles and parts](https://www.cbsa-asfc.gc.ca/trade-commerce/tariff-tarif/2026/html/02/ch87-eng.html) distinguishes bicycles from parts. Get the classification of the actual package right before comparing costs. Shipping a China-made frame from a US warehouse does not turn it into a US-origin frame.

Ask for a quote to your Canadian postal code, not an estimate copied from a US checkout. Include the currency conversion and the return destination. A low shipping charge loses some charm when an incorrectly sized cockpit must make an international round trip.

Check the dealer option too. [SEKA’s current directory](https://www.sekabikes.com/en/seka-global-dealer/) lists Canadian dealers, as does [Winspace’s](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/authorized-dealers). A listed dealer is a lead to contact, not a promise of stock or a guaranteed price.

sections.heading: Read owners for the questions they reveal
paragraphs: A [US SEKA owner writing in February 2024](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=4757.0) described a warranty experience positively. An [earlier SEKA buying thread](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=3643.15) described a long wait through a different seller. Different years and sellers make those compatible stories, not a brand-wide pass or fail.

For a stock example, a [2025 GRARO owner](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=4766.135) said a supposedly regional purchase shipped from China after local stock ran out. For your order, ask for the warehouse in writing. A few good questions are more transferable than another person’s delivery date.

Before choosing direct, find a workshop willing to build or inspect the frame and quote the work. Ask the seller who supplies a spare hanger, seatpost wedge, headset cover and any proprietary spacers. Those parts are much easier to discuss while everyone is still enthusiastic about the sale.

sections.heading: Choose with a finished-bike budget
paragraphs: Compare three totals: direct frame plus every missing part and labor; a complete bike delivered to your door; and a local dealer build with the same useful specification. Count taxes and shipping once, and label anything not yet quoted.

If direct ordering still wins, make the invoice boringly specific: model generation, size, color, bar dimensions, included hardware, dispatch window and who handles a claim. Boring paperwork is excellent preparation for an interesting bike.

zh-Hans.title: 在美国或加拿大买中国自行车：渠道、进口费用与下单核对
zh-Hans.description: 比较十个中国自行车品牌的直购、当地经销和区域仓渠道，分别说明美国与加拿大进口问题，并结合有日期的车主经历。
zh-Hans.intro: 吸引人的车架价格只是第一个数字。在美国或加拿大买车，要从真实卖家、发货国家和售后安排开始，最后得到一辆合身的车，而不是纸箱旁又多一张没预料到的账单。

sections.heading: 十个品牌，不止一种买法
paragraphs: 直购很常见，但并非唯一选择。Winspace 与 SEKA 有经销商名单；ICAN 宣传部分美国仓产品；LightCarbon 和 Dengfu 则适合按具体需求询价。同一品牌内，商品和目的地不同，购买路径也可能变化。
通过下方官方链接找到当前卖家，再问具体车型、尺码、涂装和把组。网站上的美国国旗不能证明加拿大税务处理；有区域仓，也不代表每个选项都在仓里。
这里选取十个有讨论度的品牌与车架供应商，并不声称它们是销量前十。购买路径核查于 2026 年 9 月 22 日；下单时仍需重新确认库存与条款。
bullets: [Winspace](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/authorized-dealers): 品牌商城或名单内经销商；确认具体订单的发货仓。
[Elves](https://elvesbike.com/terms.php): 品牌或当地代理；核对涂装与生产报价。
[YOELEO](https://www.yoeleobike.com/pages/shipping-and-delivery): 全球或区域商城；仓库与税费条件须按订单确认。
[ICAN](https://icancycling.com/collections/carbon-disc-wheels-usa): 品牌直购，部分产品有区域库存；核对具体货号。
[LightCarbon](https://www.lightcarbon.com/warranty_d10): 联系厂家，取得逐项车架及运费报价。
[SEKA](https://www.sekabikes.com/en/seka-global-dealer/): 从当前全球经销商名单开始。
[Tavelo](https://tavelo.cc/pages/dealer): 品牌官网与经销商查询；核对代际和库存。
[PARDUS](https://pardusbicycle.com/dealers/): 先查全球经销网络是否覆盖所在国家。
[VeloBuild](https://www.velobuild.com/place-order-a0025.html): 网站下单后，书面确认完整配置。
[Dengfu](https://m.dengfubikes.com/about/): 直接向厂家询价；确认车型、库存和套餐。

sections.heading: 美国买家：别再套用旧的 800 美元经验
paragraphs: 老论坛常说低价包裹进美国不用交税。但 [CBP 于 2026 年 2 月更新的说明](https://www.help.cbp.gov/s/article/Article-1050)指出，针对不超过 800 美元包裹的低值免税待遇，自 2025 年 8 月 29 日起对所有国家暂停。几年前的顺利进口经历不是今天的报价。
也不要用一个“通用自行车税率”替代旧规则。进口分类、原产地和当时生效措施都有关，整车不自动等同于车架或轮组。应请卖家或承运商针对实际货物说明预计费用，并在付款前查阅当前 CBP 指引。
美国本地库存可能让流程更简单，前提是宣传的到手价确实覆盖该商品与地址。[ICAN 美国仓集合页](https://icancycling.com/collections/carbon-disc-wheels-usa)是具体优惠范围的例子，不代表所有 ICAN 产品或加拿大订单都有同样待遇。
让卖家写清：若承运商额外收费，该如何处理。保存答复。不要用虚报低价、礼物或错误品名来让预算显得更好看。

sections.heading: 加拿大买家：美国商店仍在国境之外
paragraphs: 按实际运输方式查阅 [CBSA 快递进口指南](https://www.cbsa-asfc.gc.ca/import/courier/menu-eng.html)和[邮寄商品税费说明](https://www.cbsa-asfc.gc.ca/import/postal-postale/dtytx-drttx-eng.html)。关税、适用税项、快递自己的清关或报关服务费，应分开看。
[加拿大 2026 年车辆及零件税则章节](https://www.cbsa-asfc.gc.ca/trade-commerce/tariff-tarif/2026/html/02/ch87-eng.html)区分自行车与零件。比较价格前，先确认实际包裹的分类。中国制造车架从美国仓发出，并不会因此变成美国原产。
要求按你的加拿大邮编报价，别沿用美国结算页估算。还要算换汇成本，并确认退货地址。若尺码错误的把组要跨国往返，低运费就没那么诱人了。
也查经销渠道。[SEKA 当前名单](https://www.sekabikes.com/en/seka-global-dealer/)和 [Winspace 名单](https://www.winspace.cc/pages/authorized-dealers)均列有加拿大经销商。名单是联系起点，不是库存或价格保证。

sections.heading: 从车主经历里提炼该问的问题
paragraphs: 一位 [2024 年 2 月发帖的美国 SEKA 车主](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=4757.0)对保修经历评价积极；而[较早的 SEKA 购买讨论](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=3643.15)提到另一卖家的漫长等待。年份和卖家不同，这些故事可以同时成立，不能据此给整个品牌判定通过或不通过。
关于库存，[一位 2025 年 GRARO 车主](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=4766.135)说当地缺货后从中国发货。自己的订单应书面确认发货仓。有用的问题比别人的某个到货日期更容易迁移。
选择直购之前，先找到愿意装配或检查该车架的车店，并取得工时报价。再问卖家如何买备用尾钩、座管楔块、碗组上盖及专用垫圈。趁交易双方都充满热情时，问这些小配件通常更容易。

sections.heading: 用完成后的整车预算作决定
paragraphs: 比较三个总额：直购车架加所有缺件与工时、送到家的整车、以及配置相当的本地经销商装车。税费和运费只计算一次，尚未报价项目明确标记。
若直购仍然合适，就把发票写得具体到有点无聊：代际、尺码、颜色、把组尺寸、内含零件、发货窗口和索赔责任方。无聊的单据，往往是有趣自行车的好开端。
